scope: Hammer 0 only; no product behavior changes

common.edge: Cloudflare Worker clervo-api-edge-production routes api.clervo.dev/* to https://clervo-api-production-jbtbib4yqa-uc.a.run.app; edge adds x-clervo-edge-authorization and quota subject; direct origin product calls are denied without that header (documented edge_unauthorized/401).
common.commerce: x402 v2 exact and MPP charge over Base (eip155:8453), USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0xBd11d82d8Dbd01Ba3eed279d3bACf74659fFca28; quotes bind request hash/operation/price version and expire in 60 seconds. AUTO-PAY is off by default.
common.state: Postgres durable operation, accounting and replay records; operation state machine includes RECEIVED→VALIDATED→QUOTED→PAYMENT_REQUIRED→AUTHORIZED→RESERVED→EXECUTING→VERIFIED→SETTLED→RECEIPTED plus unknown/failure states. Same idempotency key and identical body replays without second authorization, execution or charge; different body is a conflict. Unknown settlement is frozen for reconciliation.
common.limits: Cloud Run gen2 clervo-api-production, 1 vCPU/512Mi, concurrency 16, max instances 5, request timeout 20s; CLERVO_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS=16. Edge request byte ceilings: search 16KiB, AI 10MiB, sandbox 1.5MB, RPC/prediction/crypto 262144 bytes. Per-operation rate-limit headers are not emitted in observed probes; exact public rate limit is unknown.
common.observability: Sentry monitoring configured; Cloud Logging retained for deployment/proof; receipts expose hashes, supplier cost and provenance. Public health: /v1/health (edge-served), /readyz and /v1/rpc/chains. /health is not a route (404).

exposure.mcp: stdio @clervo/mcp profiles; generic clervo_execute plus search_web/models_list/ai_execute and local diagnostics
exposure.router: @clervo/router local proxy/connect; hosted calls go to api.clervo.dev
exposure.pythonSdk: clervo-sdk 0.4.2; search/models/AI plus generic Connect bridge

common.supplierCosts: Prediction, RPC and Crypto configured supplier cost is 0 atomic in current pricing files; Search open federation cost basis is 2000 micro-USD (documented), Sandbox short/standard 8000/45000 micro-USD, AI route cost is model/usage-derived from qualified catalog and currently zero for the observed proof route. Where a provider tariff/remaining allowance is not technically exposed, value is unknown.
common.wallet: One shared local Router wallet (Base USDC) signs only after explicit local auto-pay/approval and spend limits; API itself never receives private key material. Owner-funded proof transactions exist; no new payment was made for this audit.
